files.title: File:Jonathan Lucas House, Calhoun Street, Medical Center, Charleston, SC - 50684899587.jpg
files.author: w_lemay
files.caption: Built before 1809, this Adamesque-style house on Calhoun Street was once home to Jonathan Lucas, a prominent local innovator of rice-milling machines.  The house’s grandeur is a reflection of the massive wealth generated by the cultivation and export of rice from the South Carolina Lowcountry in the early 19th Century.  The house is presently home to offices for the Medical University of South Carolina.
